methodNote: Per the phase charter's own instruction ('do not implement 18 independent patches... fix root causes first'), each of the 6 workstreams was independently required to add generalized adversarial variants beyond its exact audit counterexample as part of its own remediation, rather than centralizing generative testing into one separate framework after the fact. This artifact catalogs that coverage against the 12 required categories and honestly discloses where coverage is targeted-scenario-based rather than large-N randomized generation.

requiredCategoryCoverage.evidence: tests/foundation-audit/structural-coverage-remediation.test.ts, part2-adversarial-structural-assumptions.test.ts, tenant-instrument-drafting-collision.test.ts (2- and 3-way collisions); also the pre-existing 1500-case structural fuzz suite generates duplicate section/schedule/quoted-amendment labels combinatorially.
tests/foundation-audit/tenant-instrument-drafting-collision.test.ts and persistence-fault-injection.test.ts (Workstream B), generalized from 2 to 3 facilities with case/whitespace variants.
tests/foundation-audit/package-graph-adversarial.test.ts test 10/10b (Workstream C): same date + different parties, same date + same instrument type variants.
Same file - recital mentions, cross-default language, express negative-disclaimer language, and a genuine multi-target amendment (test 17) as the required positive control.

tests/foundation-audit/shared-substrate-live-retest.test.ts (case-folded heading, pre-existing), structural-coverage-remediation.test.ts's EMBEDDED_HEADING_LIKE_FRAGMENT generalization, and part4-fuzz-suite-extension.test.ts's OCR-style character substitution category (Workstream A, extending the pre-existing 1500-case fuzz suite).

tests/foundation-audit/part2-adversarial-structural-assumptions.test.ts Q1/Q3 scenarios and control cases; structural-index-fault-injection.test.ts's IMPLAUSIBLE_HIERARCHY_RANK/SIBLING_SPAN_OVERLAP cases.

tests/foundation-audit/discovery-fail-closed.test.ts D/D2/D3 (Workstream A) plus structural-coverage-remediation.test.ts's generalized gap-size/gap-position variants and full-pipeline routing proof (E2-E4).

tests/foundation-audit/effective-dating-adversarial.test.ts (Workstream D): signing-date-only, explicit-unconditional-date, date+conditions-precedent (the fix), future date, retroactive date, no-resolvable-date - all 6 required variants from the phase charter's §6E.
tests/foundation-audit/amendment-operative-state-adversarial.test.ts (Workstream D): 2-way and 3-way occurrence collisions, SECTION and DEFINITION kinds, deep-chain ambiguous-target variant.
Same file - input-order-invariance test (identical two conflicting effects run in both array orders).

tests/foundation-audit/cache-invalidation-audit.test.ts (Workstream F): structural-version-bump-forces-recompute, text-change-forces-recompute, whitespace-only-edit trade-off case, positive-control cache-hit case, force:true control.

tests/foundation-audit/cache-invalidation-audit.test.ts and persistence-fault-injection.test.ts (Workstream B): tombstone proof, positive control (no churn on unchanged replay), negative control (untouched document never pruned), fail-closed guard (empty array never wipes), 6-way concurrent-write test.

combinedGenerativeFuzzExtension.description: Workstream A extended the pre-existing 1500-case structural fuzz suite (tests/contract-model/structural-node-identity-property.test.ts) with 5 new corruption categories and a 300-case randomized combined-stress loop, per the phase charter's explicit instruction not to rely solely on syntax the parser already accepts.
newCategories: OCR-style character substitution inside the heading keyword/title itself
Alpha/roman numeral ambiguity at clause markers (sequences crossing i/v/x)
combinedGenerativeFuzzExtension.combinedLoopResult: 300 documents randomly combining all 5 new categories together: zero core-invariant violations (tests/foundation-audit/part4-fuzz-suite-extension.test.ts, 10 tests, all passing).
combinedGenerativeFuzzExtension.generatorIndependenceLimitation: As disclosed by the original 3F.1.3 audit and re-confirmed here: this generator's every corruption knob still perturbs content SURROUNDING a heading emitted in a shape SECTION_PATTERNS is built to recognize - it cannot generate a heading the parser's own regex family was never designed to recognize at all, so it structurally cannot rediscover the exact Q1/Q3 swallow/misattachment failure class (which is instead covered by the TARGETED_ADVERSARIAL tests above, not this generator). This limitation is unchanged by this remediation phase and remains an honest, disclosed boundary of what randomized fuzzing over this vocabulary can find.

honestDisclosure: This phase did not build a new, unified property-based/generative-testing framework spanning all 6 workstreams' fix areas (e.g. a single fast-check-style generator composing tenant/instrument/amendment/package-graph faults together at scale). Each workstream instead added its own generalized adversarial variants as an integral part of its root-cause fix, per the phase charter's explicit 'fix root causes first, not 18 independent patches' philosophy - this produced real, executable, passing coverage of all 12 required categories (documented above with file:test citations), but it is targeted-scenario generalization (3-5 hand-constructed variants per defect, informed by the specific failure mechanism) rather than large-N randomized property generation for the NEW fixes specifically (the pre-existing 1500+300-case structural fuzz suite remains the one large-N generator in this codebase, and Workstream A extended it). A future phase seeking stronger generative coverage of the newly-fixed subsystems (package-graph evidence classification, operative-state target resolution, context-retrieval evidence gating) would need to build dedicated generators for those domains - not attempted here given this phase's scope and time budget.
